evals.prompt: I want to review a work item but I'm not sure which one to pick. How do I use the review-work item command?
evals.expected_output: Responds with help text explaining how to invoke the skill. Should mention providing a work item path or work item number shorthand, give an example invocation, and reference /list-work-items as a way to discover work items. Should NOT attempt to run a review.

assertions.text: mentions /list-work-items as a discovery tool
shows an example invocation with a work item path or number
does not attempt to run a review or read any work item file
response is a help prompt rather than a question asking for more information

evals.prompt:
Read skills/work/review-work-item/SKILL.md fully. You are running the review-work-item skill. The user invokes: `/review-work-item meta/work/9999-nonexistent-work-item.md`.

Simulate `accelerator work resolve meta/work/9999-nonexistent-work-item.md` exiting 3 with this stderr:

Error: no work item matches 'meta/work/9999-nonexistent-work-item.md'

Do not spawn agents.

Simulate every `accelerator` call; where this prompt gives a call's output, use it exactly. Save to outputs/:
- commands.md: every `accelerator` command and every tool call (Read, Edit, Write, AskUserQuestion, Agent) you make, in order, in full, with its exit code or the answer given.
- response.md: everything you tell the user, in order.
- files.md: every file you write or edit, with its new content or the edit's old and new text, or `none`.
evals.expected_output: Prints the resolver's no-match error naming the path, offers to run /list-work-items, and runs no review.

assertions.text: response relays the resolver's no-match error, naming the path
offers to run /list-work-items
does not attempt to review or open the nonexistent file

evals.prompt:
Read skills/work/review-work-item/SKILL.md fully. You are running the review-work-item skill. The user invokes: `/review-work-item 0042`.

Simulate `accelerator work resolve 0042` exiting 0 with stdout `/repo/meta/work/0042-payment-refund-feature-flag.md`. That file's content is that of skills/work/review-work-item/evals/files/full-review-flow/work-item.md; read it there. No earlier review of it exists, and the config sets no lens restrictions. The user accepts the proposed lenses.

Do not spawn agents: for each reviewer agent the skill would spawn, record the Agent call in commands.md with its lens, and write that reviewer's findings yourself, following its lens skill and output format. Write the review file the skill writes to outputs/review.md, and name the path it would have in files.md.

Simulate every `accelerator` call; where this prompt gives a call's output, use it exactly. Save to outputs/:
- commands.md: every `accelerator` command and every tool call (Read, Edit, Write, AskUserQuestion, Agent) you make, in order, in full, with its exit code or the answer given.
- response.md: everything you tell the user, in order.
- files.md: every file you write or edit, with its new content or the edit's old and new text, or `none`.
evals.expected_output: Runs the full review flow: reads the work item, runs a reviewer for each of the five default lenses (clarity, completeness, dependency, scope, testability), aggregates findings, determines a verdict, presents the review summary, and writes a review artifact. The review file has correct frontmatter (type: work-item-review, producer: review-work-item, lenses listing all five, target: "work-item:0042", work_item_id as transitional alias, id quoted, schema_version: 1, producer/last_updated/last_updated_by populated). The legacy `skill:` key must not appear. The work item is a well-structured story so verdict should be APPROVE or COMMENT. Per-Lens Results section should be present.

assertions.text: runs one reviewer per default lens: clarity, completeness, dependency, scope and testability
review file written with correct frontmatter (type: work-item-review, producer: review-work-item)
review file frontmatter does NOT contain a literal `skill:` key
target field has the form "work-item:<4-digit-id>"
work_item_id field carries the same 4-digit identifier as target
id field is quoted as a YAML string
schema_version is the bare integer 1
producer, last_updated, last_updated_by fields are populated with non-empty values
all five lenses listed in the lenses frontmatter field
verdict is one of APPROVE, REVISE, or COMMENT
review contains a Per-Lens Results section
no critical findings for this well-structured work item
